capabilities: Render palettes in notes via sanzo fenced code blocks, including random combinations
Search all 348 combinations by color name or ID in a sidebar panel
Insert palettes at the cursor or copy hex codes to the clipboard
Star palettes as favorites saved in plugin data
Configure swatch labels and default insertion format in settings
extras: Installation is manual (download release files into .obsidian/plugins/); no community plugin store steps are given. The README states the plugin only writes to the clipboard on explicit user action and never reads it.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to browse historical color palettes or embed color swatches in notes.

relations.evidence: The color data used here is from the dictionary-of-colour-combinations package.
The data was originally compiled and open-sourced by Dain M. Blodorn Kim
relations.plugin: sanzo-wada (web project by Dain M. Blodorn Kim)

summary: Color palette tool that renders, searches, and inserts Sanzo Wada's 348 classic color combinations from a 1930s Japanese dictionary.
